calculators.name: Assembly Plastic Molding - Component loading
calculators.description: Loading the pre-made components of a multi-shot part (Pick and Place: Manual Load / Robotic Load of each AssemblyComponentGcd) every shot: each component at tblComponentLoadTime for its weight and the load method, summed per shot; a manual load is slowed by handlingMultiplier and insertionMultiplier (memory/Assembly plastic molding variables), a robot is not.

source.engine: load_time_s (tblComponentLoadTime of each component by its weight and the load method, summed per shot)
manual (1 for a manual load, 0 for a robot)

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: {Load Time} * ({Manual Load} * {Handling Multiplier} * {Insertion Multiplier} + 1 - {Manual Load}) * {Cycle Time Factor}

calculators.name: Assembly Plastic Molding - Multi-shot cycle
calculators.description: The cycle of a multi-shot press (approved 2026-11-19: overlapped). Every station molds at once, each shot into its own stage, so the press waits for the longest shot (its fill, pack, cool and mold open/close by the injection cycle-time calculator with that shot's material); the components load at a station while the shots mold. Then the mold indexes (rotary table, rotating stack or core turn) for the press's tool index time (memory: toolIndexTime). A helper: no catalog operation maps to it.

source.engine: longest_shot_cycle_s (the longest of the shots' injection cycles)
component_load_s (the component loading of the shot, 0 without components)

fields.name: Shot Cycle
fields.formula: max({Longest Shot Cycle}, {Load Time}) + {Tool Index Time}
